name: flowsint
description: A modern platform for visual, flexible, and extensible graph-based investigations. For cybersecurity analysts and investigators.
one_liner: A visual tool for investigators that lets them build a map of connections — people, companies, accounts — while researching a case, instead of tracking everything in scattered notes.
buyer: A corporate due-diligence or fraud-investigation analyst who needs to map relationships between entities during a vendor or partner background check.
business_use_cases: A due-diligence firm uses it to build and present relationship maps when vetting new business partners or vendors for clients.
A private investigator uses it to organize and visualize findings across a multi-person fraud case.
A corporate security team maps insider-threat or supply-chain risk relationships during an internal investigation.

money_ideas.idea: Offer a one-off 'vendor background check' investigation service for small businesses vetting new partners.
Run a hosted, per-seat subscription version for investigation teams that need it regularly.

steal_this: Offer small businesses a $300 'know who you're really doing business with' vendor background-check report this weekend, built using this tool.
